mapper.select: SELECT b.id AS bed_id, b.bed_no, r.id AS room_id, r.room_no, r.room_name, r.room_type, r.gender_type, r.price FROM hostel_bed b INNER JOIN hostel_room r ON r.id = b.room_id WHERE b.deleted = 0 AND b.status = 1 AND r.deleted = 0 AND r.status = 1 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM booking_order bo WHERE bo.deleted = 0 AND bo.bed_id = b.id AND bo.order_status IN (2, 3, 4) AND bo.check_in_date < #{checkOutDate} AND #{checkInDate} < bo.check_out_date ) ORDER BY r.price ASC, r.id ASC, b.sort_no ASC, b.id ASC

SELECT b.id AS bed_id, b.bed_no, r.id AS room_id, r.room_no, r.room_name, r.room_type, r.gender_type, r.price FROM hostel_bed b INNER JOIN hostel_room r ON r.id = b.room_id WHERE b.deleted = 0 AND b.status = 1 AND r.deleted = 0 AND r.status = 1 AND ( (#{userGender} = 1 AND r.gender_type IN (1, 3)) OR (#{userGender} = 2 AND r.gender_type IN (2, 3)) ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM booking_order bo WHERE bo.deleted = 0 AND bo.bed_id = b.id AND bo.order_status IN (2, 3, 4) AND bo.check_in_date < #{checkOutDate} AND #{checkInDate} < bo.check_out_date ) ORDER BY r.price ASC, r.id ASC, b.sort_no ASC, b.id ASC

SELECT b.id AS bed_id, b.bed_no, r.id AS room_id, r.room_no, r.room_name, r.room_type, r.gender_type, r.price FROM hostel_bed b INNER JOIN hostel_room r ON r.id = b.room_id WHERE b.deleted = 0 AND b.status = 1 AND r.deleted = 0 AND r.status = 1 AND r.id = #{roomId} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM booking_order bo WHERE bo.deleted = 0 AND bo.bed_id = b.id AND bo.order_status IN (2, 3, 4) AND bo.check_in_date < #{checkOutDate} AND #{checkInDate} < bo.check_out_date ) ORDER BY b.sort_no ASC, b.id ASC
